blockers.finding: Declared first_progress_s is 300; result_path calls.jsonl receives its first measured record only after up to 300 health iterations (2 s sleep plus health timeout), linkage checks and a completed warm inference (timeout 3600). Static review cannot establish first progress within 300 s, and no successful same-packet first-progress evidence is present in reviewed packet. This is an unverified acceptance condition, not proof the run necessarily exceeds 300 s.

first_progress_300_600.do_not: Do not simply replace first_progress_s=300 with 600 and claim acceptance. The load loop alone can exceed 600 s when health requests consume their timeout; warm inference adds up to 3600 s.
first_progress_300_600.exact_next_action: Owning session obtains native same-packet first-progress evidence at 300 s. If it fails due to measured load/warm latency, prepare a new successor with first_progress_s set to a justified observed bound and run native first-progress again. A numerical replacement cannot be justified from static evidence alone.
first_progress_300_600.optional_hard_bound: If the contractual limit remains 300 s, enforce a shared monotonic start+300 deadline across health/linkage/warm inference and fail incomplete before that limit; this bounds failure but does not substitute for a PASS.
